name: The room server killed mid-session
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: Every visitor in a room is back in within 10 s of the room server returning, its owl where it stood (OP-087).
blast_radius: This machine's throwaway park only: its Worker and room server process, killed and kept down for 3 s; the stand-in store and the scripted visitors carry on.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: visitors back in after the room server returned
observations.fix: every page that was in a room is let back in once the room server returns

observations.what: the slowest visitor back, from the room server returning
observations.fix: a page tries again sooner after a dropped socket (apps/park/src/net/edge.ts: the backoff's ceiling)

observations.what: owls let back in more than 60 px from where they stood
observations.fix: keep where each owl stood through a restart: the room's memory of owls that left (Room.ts leavers) lives only in memory, so after a restart a hello's position is trusted only near the spawn
